name: Academy of Wisgon
source:
When Magic Calls, Will You Answer?

A talking cat appears in your room one sleepless night and whisks you away to Wisgon Academy—a secret school of magic hidden from the world. You're part of a controversial new program that recruits outsiders into a society that has remained closed for centuries.

But the wizarding world is far from welcoming. Ancient bloodlines clash with new possibilities, and you find yourself caught between tradition and change. The academy is divided, tensions simmer beneath polished facades, and not everyone believes you belong.

As you navigate this world of wonder and conflict, you'll encounter a diverse cast of characters—each with their own agendas, secrets, and hearts to win or lose. From rivals to allies, from mysterious mentors to unexpected friends, every relationship you forge will shape your journey through the academy's hidden depths.

But in a place where magic and politics intertwine, some secrets are best left buried. And some doors, once opened, can never be closed.

A tale of belonging and mystery in a world that wasn't meant for you. Build meaningful relationships, navigate dangerous rivalries, and uncover the truth lurking in the shadows.

Your choices matter. Your bonds define you. Your destiny awaits.
